title: Blue Mountain Beach "Just One More" 16 N Spooky Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Just One More" 16 N Spooky Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Short walk to deeded beach access- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**- Convenient location- Large porches- Propane firepit- 5 adult bikes provided- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: "Just One More," a stunning home in Blue Mountain Beach, is perfectly appointed for your next dream vacation! This 3-level home is located just 800 feet from the beach and offers beautiful accommodations for 16 guests, a gorgeous private pool, and incredible coastal views - everything you need for your luxury getaway!Through the first-floor entryway, guests are greeted by coastal interiors. This level offers a king bedroom with a shared bathroom, which features a beautiful marble vanity and double sinks, and a marble-tiled, glass-front shower. Also on this level is a bunk area with a built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed - a perfect setup on this floor for a small family! Climb the stairs - or take the home's elevator - to the second floor and enjoy the main living space's open-concept layout. The gourmet kitchen is a cook's dream. It is thoughtfully equipped with Carrera marble countertops and a gorgeous tile backsplash, bright white custom cabinetry, stainless steel KitchenAid appliances, a Thermador gas range, a wine refrigerator, and a large kitchen island. The nearby dining area provides seating for eight guests, with an additional four seats available at the breakfast bar. In the living room, guests will enjoy a variety of comfortable seating options and the large flat-screen television. This main living level is elegantly decorated in neutral tones, and the room's many windows provide abundant natural light. A set of French doors lead the way to a spacious covered porch, which features an outdoor dining set for eight guests. Conveniently located on this second level is a king bed primary bedroom with a mounted flat-screen television and en suite bathroom with a large glass-front shower and marble vanity.On the third level are three additional bedrooms. The primary suite offers a beautiful king bed, French doors to access the balcony, and en-suite bathroom with marble vanity, double sinks, and a shower. Down the hall, a bunk room provides three twin-over-twin built-in bunk beds and a private bathroom with a shower and single marble vanity. The third bedroom on this level features a beautiful king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Enjoy the beach views from the third-floor covered balcony - a relaxing place to have morning coffee or sunset cocktails. On the main level, guests will enjoy the outdoor living area, which offers an outdoor kitchen with a built-in gas grill, mini-fridge, and sink. It also features plenty of comfortable seating, a large mounted flat-screen television, two outdoor dining sets, and private pool. Book your Blue Mountain Beach getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bunk Room: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments. You may also be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
